items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of Zuzahlungsbefreiung
items.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Allgemeinen Musterkasse erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated (and presumably posted) 20.12.2024, a Friday. The letter itself states the pre-2025 rule: a letter sent by ordinary post is deemed delivered on the 3rd day after posting, which matches the statutory rule for postings on or before 31.12.2024 (PostModG). 20.12.2024 + 3 days = 23.12.2024 (Monday). This sender is a statutory health insurer (social-law body), so the deemed-delivery day does not shift even though it would matter if it fell on a weekend/holiday (it does not here, it's a Monday). The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) then runs from 23.12.2024: the day of delivery itself is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB analog), and the period ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 23.01.2025 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB analog). 23.01.2025 is a Thursday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no further shift is needed.
